notes: 3-axis initial request review (depth, width, urgency). Asked once on the first user turn of a session across a paired decider call from two distinct model families.
Reconciled conservatively: max(a, b) on depth and width, min(a, b) on urgency. No task taxonomy until post-epoch outcome data accumulates.

depth.instructions: How deep is the work requested? Assess required reasoning, investigation, interpretation, and resolution of uncertainty.

criteria.2: Diagnosis, interacting constraints, or substantial tradeoffs
criteria.3: Open-ended investigation, competing hypotheses, or novel design
criteria.unknown: Supplied material does not support an assessment

width.instructions: How wide is the work requested? Assess expected breadth of actions, deliverables, dependencies, and coordination.

criteria.2: Several connected changes, dependencies, or deliverables
criteria.3: Broad work across systems, stages, or delegated assignments
criteria.unknown: Supplied material does not support an assessment

urgency.instructions: How specific and action-ready is the request? Assess how strongly the request supports an expectation of immediate execution without guesswork.

criteria.0: Intended result cannot yet be identified
criteria.1: Goal recognizable, with consequential choices unresolved
criteria.3: Clear enough to execute without consequential guesswork
criteria.unknown: Supplied material does not support an assessment
